name: level
meaning: PROPERTY LEVEL; 13 selects the variant (flags bit2): anim set 7/2/4, box collision on

name: textCamera
meaning: PROPERTY TEXTCAMERA camera setup {u16 focal; u16 rot[3]; Vec3s pos} for Camera_StartScripted

name: choicePages
meaning: node array (root + nbChoices + 1) built by Menu_BuildList

name: choiceMenu
meaning: Menu record written by Menu_BuildList; count +0xfc used for the box height

name: questionBox
meaning: text = QUESTIONTEXT, +0x110 = &choicePages, +0x114 = &choiceMenu, cursorRow +0x118, fits +0x11c, rect +0x120 (centred), bgColor +0x128

name: flags
meaning: DaffyLevel01Flags: 1 Wolf frozen by this object, 2 Train level (anims 0/1), 4 LEVEL==13 variant

name: menuJustOpened
meaning: 1 on the frame of msg 1; blocks the confirm press on that frame; cleared at the end of Update
